topic: Write about Body Language across Cultures(写一篇关于跨文化肢体语言的短文)
genre: 说明文 / 议论(explain how body language varies across cultures + give advice)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 4 Reading for Writing:写一篇关于肢体语言/跨文化手势/如何更好沟通的说明短文(描述差异 + 给出建议)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,你的英国笔友 Chris 下个月将第一次来中国。请用英语写一篇约80词的短文,内容包括:① 说明肢体语言因文化而异(举一两个例子,如手势/眼神/问候);② 给 Chris 一两条在中国得体使用肢体语言的建议;③ 表达欢迎他来的心情。注意:句子围绕中心、地道连贯。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your British pen-friend Chris will visit China for the first time next month. Write a short passage (about 80 words) including: 1) explain that body language varies from culture to culture, with one or two examples (gestures, eye contact, greetings); 2) one or two pieces of advice for using body language politely in China; 3) say that you welcome his visit.
points: 说明肢体语言因文化而异(Body language varies from culture to culture)
举例(For example, the same gesture may mean … / eye contact …)
给出得体建议(My advice is … / You'd better avoid …)
表达欢迎(I look forward to seeing you in China!)
model_essay: Dear Chris, I'm so glad you're coming to China next month! One thing worth knowing is that body language varies from culture to culture. For example, a gesture that is friendly at home may mean something different here, and staring at someone too long can be read as rude. My advice is simple: watch how local people behave, keep your eye contact polite, and a warm smile is always welcome. Don't worry about small mistakes — we'll all understand. I really look forward to seeing you and showing you around!
model_translation: 亲爱的 Chris,很高兴你下个月要来中国!有一点值得了解:肢体语言因文化而异。比如,在你家乡友好的手势在这里也许含义不同,盯着别人看太久也可能被当作无礼。我的建议很简单:观察当地人怎么做,眼神接触要得体,温暖的微笑永远受欢迎。别担心小失误——我们都会理解。我真的很期待见到你,带你四处看看!

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:说明文化差异 / 得体建议 / 表达欢迎
围绕肢体语言展开、句句相关、行文连贯、衔接自然
句型词汇准确多样、动名词等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 点题 Body language varies from culture to culture.
举例 For example, the same gesture may mean something different here.
建议 My advice is to watch local people and keep eye contact polite.
欢迎 I look forward to seeing you in China!
key_expressions: Body language varies from culture to culture.
A gesture that is friendly at home may be rude here.
Watch how local people behave and keep your eye contact polite.
A warm smile is always welcome.

high_sentences: Body language varies from culture to culture.
A gesture that is friendly at home may mean something quite different here.
Watch how local people behave, and keep your eye contact polite.
A warm smile is always welcome almost everywhere.

error_pairs.wrong: I look forward to see you.
error_pairs.correct: I look forward to seeing you.
error_pairs.note: look forward to 中 to 是介词,后接动名词。
主语第三人称单数,动词加 s。
avoid 后接动名词,不接不定式。

第2-3句 举例:For example, the same gesture / eye contact may …
第4-5句 建议:My advice is to … and keep your eye contact polite.
